message.event_overview: Multiple coronal mass ejections reached Earth beginning at 1639 UTC Fri May 10 2024, producing G3-G5 geomagnetic storming. Solar particle storm conditions also reached SP2. The event remains ongoing, with another series of coronal mass ejections expected to influence Earth on Sun May 12 2024.
message.what_has_occurred: An interplanetary shock was detected at 1639 UTC Fri May 10 2024, followed by a sudden impulse at 1645 UTC Fri May 10 2024. The proposed 12-station Kp application subsequently confirmed G3 and G5 conditions. A G4 Observed Space Weather Alert would also have been issued at first application confirmation; that repetitive prototype is not reproduced in this package. Solar wind conditions became strongly enhanced, with very strong magnetic fields, sustained southward conditions, and speeds near 800 km/s. Active Region 3664 remained highly active and produced an X5.8 flare near 0123 UTC Sat May 11 2024. A halo coronal mass ejection associated with this activity remains under analysis.
message.current_status: Geomagnetic storming remains in progress at 1800 UTC Sat May 11 2024. Periods of G3-G4 conditions remain expected, with additional G5 periods possible if coronal mass ejection-driven conditions strengthen again.
message.what_is_expected: There is an 80% chance of renewed coronal mass ejection impact between 0600 UTC Sun May 12 2024 and 1800 UTC Sun May 12 2024, with the most likely impact near 1200 UTC Sun May 12 2024. There is a 60% chance that disturbed conditions will last at least 12 hours after renewed impact and a 15% chance of warning-level conditions continuing beyond 0000 UTC Mon May 13 2024.
message.impacts: Operational concerns include power-system voltage control and geomagnetically induced currents, HF communication degradation, GNSS uncertainty, increased low-Earth-orbit satellite drag, and particle-related concerns for aviation and satellite operations. Refer to the active Warning and sector-specific decision-support guidance for detailed actions.
message.active_products: A Space Weather Warning remains in effect through 0600 UTC Mon May 13 2024. Warning Updates, Observed Space Weather Alerts, Notices, and partner briefings will be issued as conditions and forecast expectations change.
message.next_summary: No later than 1800 UTC Sun May 12 2024, or sooner if conditions materially change.
